hero.title: Saving a life shouldn't require a miracle. Just a match.
hero.description: Raksha AI connects voluntary blood donors with Thalassemia patients across India — through intelligent matching, automated scheduling, and care that never stops.

mission.quote: Every Thalassemia patient deserves a donor who keeps coming back.
mission.desc1: Thalassemia Major is a genetic blood disorder that requires lifelong blood transfusions — typically every 2-3 weeks. Without regular transfusions, patients face severe anemia, organ damage, and shortened life expectancy.
mission.desc2: In India alone, over 1 lakh children are born with Thalassemia Major every year. Each patient needs 500-700 transfusions over their lifetime. That's not just 500 blood bags — it's 500 moments of uncertainty, coordination, and hope.
mission.desc3: Raksha AI was built to eliminate that uncertainty. We match patients with committed donors, predict transfusion needs, and ensure no patient ever faces a shortage alone.

footer.description: Protecting lives, one match at a time. Raksha AI is transforming blood donation in India through intelligent matching and care coordination.
